headline: Role of Ulema, Sufis Vital to Understanding Pakistan’s Ideology
clippingAlt: The News International: Role of Ulema, Sufis vital to understanding Pakistan's ideology
body: Prominent national coverage highlighting the key addresses delivered at the seminar organized jointly by the Institute of Regional Studies (IRS) and Khair Publications. The report documents how speakers emphasized that the spiritual traditions of Sufi saints and Muslim scholars form the intellectual cornerstone of Pakistan's ideological identity.

The article specifically features the formal launch of the newly published English translations of “Sufism” and “Truthful Tales” by Khair Publications, recognizing their contribution to introducing authentic Islamic thought to global English-speaking audiences.
